summary: L3Harris Technologies (filer) disclosed through a wholly owned subsidiary (Aerojet Rocketdyne, AJRD) that it entered definitive agreements with the U.S. Department of War for a $1 billion investment in AJRD's Series A Convertible Preferred Stock and warrants. The investment funds facility expansion and R&D. The Series A converts into common at 80% of an IPO price; warrants cover 3% of fully diluted common at 110% of IPO price. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring is involved; this is a strategic government investment, not a special-situation event such as a going-private or activist campaign.
